### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Rename the Default notification level to When action is required](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3387) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a session's Notifications menu, on its page and its row in the Sessions list, `Default` is now `When action is required`: a question, a confirmation, a sign-in or a failed turn. What it notifies is unchanged.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.34.0...v3.34.1
